channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: La Jolla attorney disbarred for allegedly harassing legal social media influencer ‘Law by Mike’
item.description: A La Jolla attorney was disbarred for sending over 3,000 threatening messages "Law by Mike," a legal influencer with millions of followers.

item.title: Opinion: Would you or I get the same media coverage Nancy Guthrie is receiving?
item.description: The 84-year-old Tucson resident, best known as the mother of NBC News personality Savannah Guthrie, has been missing since Feb. 1.

item.title: Beach and Bay Press: Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: The Beach & Bay Press covers city halting the Turquoise Tower in PB over developer's conflicting hotel/apartment claims, Pacific Beach memorial for a young cyclist killed by driver, new Italian deli and Neapolitan pizza openings, Mission Bay students' documentary score, PB Elementary upgrades, and local tennis win.

item.title: Haitian community fears deportation, death with immigration program on chopping block
item.description: The Trump administration wants to do away with Temporary Protected Status for immigrants from Haiti, sparking a court battle.

item.title: South Bay’s National School District honored by state for green initiatives
item.description: The district secured 'Green Achiever' status by saving over 1 million gallons of water annually, while diverting 1,000-plus tons of waste.

item.title: Eight concerts to see this week in San Diego
item.description: Whether your tastes run to film soundtracks, jazz standards, or soulful blues, you'll find something to satisfy your audio appetite.

item.title: News director Terence Shepherd leaves KPBS
item.description: KPBS management told staffers that Vinnee Tong, the station’s managing editor, will serve as interim news director, effective Wednesday.

item.title: Man accused of impersonating officer, battery of victim he called an ‘illegal alien’
item.description: After San Diego police arrived, they detained the man, who allegedly claimed he was a law enforcement officer and tried to make an arrest.

item.title: Stretch of Texas Street set for repairs late Friday ahead of several days of rain
item.description: The Texas Street closure, from 8 p.m. Friday to continue 10 a.m. Saturday, includes repair of a stormwater channel and embankment.

item.title: At San Diego border, Kristi Noem blasts funding shutdown, claims drug-smuggling wins
item.description: In addition to drug seizures, Noem highlighted DHS’s roles like the TSA, Coast Guard and Secret Service, making a case for the utility of the department beyond the roving patrols of immigration agents that have been under public scrutiny for the past year.
